mapper.update: update `group` set group_name = #{groupName}, group_description = #{groupDescription}, group_type = #{groupType}, update_time = CURRENT_TIMESTAMP() where group_id = #{groupId}
mapper.delete: delete from group_member where group_id = #{groupId} and user_id = #{userId}
mapper.update: update `group` set member_count = member_count - 1 where group_id = #{groupId} and member_count > 0
update `group` set user_id = #{newRoot}, update_time = CURRENT_TIMESTAMP() where group_id = #{groupId} and user_id = #{oldRoot}
update group_member set role = 'ROOT', update_time = CURRENT_TIMESTAMP() where group_id = #{groupId} and user_id = #{userId} and join_status = 'APPROVED' and role <> 'ROOT'
mapper.delete: delete from group_member where group_id = #{groupId} and user_id = #{userId} and role = 'ROOT'
mapper.select: select gm.user_id from group_member gm where gm.group_id = #{groupId} and gm.join_status = 'APPROVED' and gm.role <> 'ROOT' and gm.user_id <> #{leaverId} order by (gm.role = 'ADMIN') desc, gm.update_time desc, gm.group_member_id asc limit 1
mapper.delete: delete from `group` where group_id = #{groupId} and not exists (select 1 from group_member gm where gm.group_id = #{groupId} and gm.join_status = 'APPROVED')
